text:
maya: FYI escalation from Acme-ML — their p99 jumped from ~800ms to ~4.5s this morning after the latest model rollout, and they see intermittent API 500s. Customer reports time window 07:12–07:40 UTC.

maya: snippet from their support dump:
```
2026-02-28T07:15:22Z ERROR inference: request failed: rpc error: code = Internal desc = CUDA out of memory when allocating 346MB
...
runtime: kv_cache_size=12.9GB -> 18.4GB over 20m
allocator: failed to allocate 4MB slab (active_frag=0.67)
```

maya: They said this affects a single tenant (acme-prod) running the 2.1-large model variant on dedicated pool-gpu-4.

jon: thanks — tagging @tess for SRE help. maya, can you paste route id + example request id?

maya: route is /v1/generate (route_id: r-87ac), sample req id 01F3XQ1BQ.

tess: looking at infra metrics now — I see memory pressure on node gpu-4-12 around 07:10, p95 token latency spikes align with KV growth.

tess: interesting: KV cache growth rate jumped after a burst of long-context requests from that tenant (seq_len ~ 8192). KV entries scaled up, evictions didn't keep pace -> fragmentation + allocator churn.

kevin: is this the same allocator regression we saw in canary last month? we had jemalloc config change that reduced coalescing.

jon: not the same patch, but similar symptom. Model 2.1-large has slightly different KV layout and we noticed higher per-request KV retention.

raj: customer is upset, wants ETA. They reported degraded UX in their search app.

maya: they asked for immediate mitigation: can we route traffic to 2.1-medium or fallback older 1.9 variant?

jon: short-term mitigation options: 1) route acme-prod to 2.1-medium (lower KV per request) 2) enable strict per-tenant KV caps (soft reject/slowdown) 3) restart the worker to defragment memory but that causes in-flight failures.

tess: I'm leaning to routing to 2.1-medium + enable per-tenant KV soft-cap at 10GB. That buys time while we debug fragmentation.

deploy-bot: canary rollback for model r-87ac requested by jon — starting traffic shift (20% -> 100% to 2.1-medium)

jon: will schedule the rollback now, switching canary. maya, let customer know we will do a non-disruptive traffic shift to the medium variant and monitor for 20m.

maya: told them that, they want logs/confirmation once p99 drops.

tess: investigating allocator internals — on gpu-4-12 I see jemalloc stats:
```
allocated: 23.7GB
active: 24.9GB
dirty: 4.1GB
arenas: 48
fragmentation_ratio: 1.18
small_alloc_failures: 342
```

tess: the dirty pages are high and we have lots of small allocation failures during KV churn which leads to fallback into slower paths and page reclaim — explains the latency tail.

kevin: quick diag idea: try toggling aggressive_page_purge=1 on that node to reclaim dirty pages; risk is transient performance dip but may relieve OOM pressure. Also consider bumping allocator coalescing window.

jon: agree. Also double-check that the KV eviction policy is LRU-by-tenant, not global LRU that can be gamed by bursts.

tess: we're enabling soft-cap and evictions now. I'll also run aggressive purge after traffic finishes shifting.

tess: action items:
- route acme-prod -> 2.1-medium (jon)
- enable per-tenant KV soft-cap = 10GB and LRU enforcement (kevin)
- aggressive page purge on gpu-4-12 after shift (tess)
- collect jemalloc + nvml + perf counters for 30m window (tess)
- run repro harness to simulate long-context burst (jon)

jon: rolling out routing change now. expecting effect visible in ~5m.

tess: purge started (aggressive_page_purge=1) on gpu-4-12. Purge logs:
```
2026-02-28T07:23:12Z PURGE started, reclaimed 2.8GB dirty pages
2026-02-28T07:24:05Z PURGE completed, active=21.2GB dirty=1.1GB
```

tess: after purge p99 on that node dropped from ~4.5s -> ~720ms, p95 ~220ms. KV cache size stabilized.

maya: customer confirms improvement: their p99 is back to baseline, they saw 70% fewer 500s. Thanks team.

raj: customer is asking for root cause writeup and long-term fix.

jon: preliminary RCA: tenant long-context workload caused sudden KV growth + many small allocations; jemalloc coalescing + dirty page accumulation triggered fragmentation and small alloc failures -> fallback slow paths -> p99 explosion. Mitigations: per-tenant KV caps, route heavy tenants to larger instance types or lower-variant; allocator tuning for coalescing and periodic purge.

tess: follow-ups:
- SRE to test allocator coalescing tweaks in staging (tess)
- Runtime to add per-tenant KV monitoring and auto-soft-cap (jon)
- Ops to add automatic aggressive-page-purge hook when dirty>2GB (kevin)

maya: I'll send customer the ETA and RCA draft once we have the staging test plan.

kevin: noted — I'll open infra ticket INF-2026-114 for allocator tuning and automation.

jon: i'll link repro harness + perf traces in the ticket.

maya: great. closing loop with Acme in 1hr and will keep this thread updated. :white_check_mark:
